node-1.label: A 47-year-old woman presented for evaluation of a cardiac murmur without displaying any cardiac symptoms

node-2.label: Heart murmur had been detected at age 3; she had no daily physical restriction except in physical education class, gave birth to two children at ages 26 and 27 without complications, and had no family history of cardiac conditions

node-3.label: The patient noticed her fingers and shoe size getting bigger in her early 30s and experienced menopause at 35 years of age; thickening of all fingers, lips, and nose was observed

node-4.label: Physical examination: height 154.6 cm, weight 63.3 kg (BMI 26.5 kg/m²), blood pressure 106/56 mm Hg, heart rate 68 beats/min, cardiac exam revealed a 4/6 systolic ejection murmur at the second to third left sternal border
